# Tea Naamansen Nikolov

Tea Naamansen Nikolov is named once in the corpus as Datamanager (data manager) at Afdeling 3 of RKKP's Videncenter [^src1]. This role places her among the staff supporting the ADHD-databasen, a Danish health database that monitors the quality of diagnostic assessment and treatment for ADHD in children and young people under 18 [^src1]. The listing appears within a set of steering group and staff members for the database, whose broader membership includes chief physicians, specialists, psychologists, nurses, epidemiologists, and relative representatives from across Denmark [^src1]. No further details about her responsibilities, background, or activities are available in the source material.
